  "identity_client.py": "import os
import base64
import hashlib
import secrets

# Google OAuth2/OIDC Configuration
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/google/callback")

# Auth0 PKCE Configuration
AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/auth0/callback")

def generate_pkce_verifier(length: int = 128) -> str:
    return secrets.token_urlsafe(length)

def generate_pkce_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
    s256 = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode('utf-8')).digest()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(s256).decode('utf-8').replace('=', '')

  "audit_summary.py": "import os
import anthropic

def summarize_audit_events(events: list[dict], user_id: str) -> str:
    anthropic_api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
    if not anthropic_api_key:
        raise ValueError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    
    client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=anthropic_api_key)
    
    event_strings = [f"Event Type: {e.get('event_type')}, Timestamp: {e.get('timestamp')}, Details: {e.get('details')}" for e in events]
    context_str = "\n".join(event_strings)

    response = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-3-haiku-20240307",
        max_tokens=200,
        messages=[
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Summarize the following login audit events for user ID {user_id}. Focus on key actions and any anomalies:\n\n{context_str}"
            }
        ]
    )
    return response.content[0].text

def moderate_free_text_claim(text: str) -> dict:
    openai_api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not openai_api_key:
        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    
    client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=openai_api_key)
    
    response = client.moderations.create(input=text)
    
    moderation_result = response.results[0]

        "flagged": moderation_result.flagged,
        "categories": {
            category.name: category.value for category in moderation_result.categories
        },
        "category_scores": {
            score.name: score.value for score in moderation_result.category_scores
        }
    }
